scope: Forty-seven exact base-paper consequence sites: two tedy, že phrase recasts and 45 ordinary token-level transitions.
choice: Recast the two phrase-level clauses as Zato požadanje znači, že and Zato prědpokladajemo, že; replace 39 lowercase and six uppercase ordinary transitions with zato/Zato.
motivation: German and proof syntax classify all sites as conclusions. Phrase-level recasting avoids unidiomatic internal tedy, že while retaining proposition content.
alternatives_rejected: Token-only replacement in the two guarded phrases would be syntactically clumsy.
Two later tym samym collision sites remain separately guarded.

evidence.semantic_review: German controls Die Forderung besagt also, daß and Wir nehmen also an bind the phrase recasts; all 45 other sites are proof/result transitions.

validation.coverage: two exact phrase anchors plus 45 exact line-and-ordinal tokens
validation.postcondition: selected sites zero; 131 base tokens deliberately untouched
validation.structure: TeX controls, braces, math delimiters and line counts invariant
validation.reproducibility: frozen successor hashes reproduced before atomic apply
